description: This file defines the `SeoUrl` class within the Opencart e-commerce system, specifically for handling SEO URL-related database queries such as fetching URLs by keyword or key-value pairs. It is part of the catalog model for the design component.

classes.name: SeoUrl
classes.description: A model class for managing SEO URL database interactions, including retrieval by keyword or key-value pair, in the Opencart system.

methods.name: getSeoUrlByKeyword
methods.description: Retrieves a SEO URL record from the database matching a specific keyword, considering store ID.

methods.name: getSeoUrlByKeyValue
methods.description: Retrieves a SEO URL record based on a key-value pair, considering store ID and language ID.
